apply_vmap_transform: apply vmap to vectorize a function over a batch dimension with configurable in_dims and out_dims
restore_vmap_execution: restore a paused vmap execution that returns outputs and their batch dimension locations
wrap_batched_inputs: wrap tensor arguments into BatchedTensors given batch dimensions and a vmap nesting level
unwrap_batched_outputs: unwrap batched tensor outputs back to regular tensors and return their out_dims pytree
disable_saved_tensors_hooks: disable saved tensor hooks on a function and raise an error if they are used
